# Twouring 遊遊

> Twouring 遊遊（遊遊股份有限公司，統一編號 95440838）是台灣的企業 AI 導入與城市數位轉型顧問公司。協助企業做 AI 營運健檢、90 天路線圖、流程自動化與內訓；協助地方政府規劃數位遊牧城市策略、友善場域與國際人才接待。

## What Twouring is

Twouring 遊遊是企業 AI 導入顧問，也是城市數位轉型與數位遊牧策略顧問。合作從免費的 30 分鐘需求初談開始，再進入付費診斷、顧問／PMO 與導入。技術交付可由合作夥伴適才科技承接；TDNA 為公益生態系連結，不是遊遊的付費客戶關係。

## Awarded government cases

### 花蓮雲基地營運推廣計畫
https://www.twouring.com/cases/hualien-cloud-base/

Client: 花蓮縣政府. Public contract award: NTD 5,880,000 (tender award total, not company profit). Twouring role: contracted vendor — advisory, integration, PMO.

### 臺東 TTNomads
https://www.twouring.com/cases/taitung-ttnomads/

Client: 臺東縣政府. Public contract award: NTD 2,400,000. Twouring role: contracted vendor — advisory, programme and venue integration. Cumulative published awards with Hualien: NTD 8,280,000.

## Services (definitions)

- Enterprise AI consulting: diagnose processes first, then adopt AI with a 90-day roadmap, KPIs and PMO. Starting package: AI operations health-check from NTD 120,000.
- AI corporate training: executive workshops from NTD 100,000 per session.
- AI workflow automation: identify the three workflows most worth automating and measure ROI.
- Remote / hybrid work consulting: policies, collaboration and performance systems (separate purchase from AI).
- Digital-nomad city strategy: maturity diagnostic, strategy and annual advisory for local governments.
- Nomad-friendly venues: internationalisation for stays, cafés and districts; Nomad Ready is the method name.
- International visits: Taiwan business delegation and startup ecosystem visit design (not travel agency booking).

## Entry ladder

1. Insights / talks (no custom strategy)
2. 30-minute discovery call (free)
3. Paid diagnostic (NTD 30,000–200,000)
4. Advisory / PMO (NTD 80,000–250,000/mo)
5. Rollout / annual (NTD 300,000–3,000,000+)
